architecture.name: Shared-embedding quadratic network
architecture.formula: h[j] = (E[a,j] + E[b,j])^2; logits[c] = sum_j h[j] U[j,c]
builtInAssumptions: Inputs are discrete tokens, represented by learned lookup rows.
The two inputs share E, so commutativity is built in.
The hidden activation is a square; there is no bias.
No Fourier features or correct arithmetic rule are supplied.

training.initialization: Independent normal(mean=0, std=0.2) for E and U
training.evaluation: All displayed metrics recomputed from exported rounded weights.
training.selection: Exploratory settings chosen after small pilot runs; seeds fixed before final runs. Held-out pairs were excluded from updates but used to inspect pilot performance.

interventions.frequencyPower: Each positive Fourier pair's energy in E, divided by total non-DC energy. This measures representation strength, not causal importance.
interventions.remove: Subtract one real sine/cosine pair from every column of E. Keep U fixed and rerun inference.
interventions.only: Keep the mean of each E column and only the selected sine/cosine pair. Keep U fixed.
interventions.caution: An ablation is an artificial intervention. A drop establishes dependence under this intervention; it does not identify a complete algorithm or imply a unique explanation.
interventions.control: Subtract one seeded uniform random embedding direction projected outside both DC and the selected Fourier pair. Scale its Frobenius norm to equal the removed Fourier component. The direction is fixed per frequency across all runs/checkpoints. This matches perturbation size, not spectrum or semantic effect; it is one control, not a statistical ensemble.
interventions.controlRandomness: xorshift32, seed = uint32(0x9e3779b9 XOR uint32(frequency*0x85ebca6b)); row-major samples uint32(state)/2^32*2-1

sources.title: Progress measures for grokking via mechanistic interpretability

scope: Purpose-built educational neural-network experiment inspired by the cited papers, not a reproduction of their transformer architectures or a claim of Clock/Pizza identification.
